WITH product_contribution AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.product_id,
        p.brand,
        p.category,
        p.brand_tier,
        oi.platform,
        SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) AS revenue_eur,
        SUM(oi.cost_eur * oi.quantity) AS cost_eur,
        SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) - SUM(oi.cost_eur * oi.quantity) AS contribution_eur,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity) - SUM(oi.cost_eur * oi.quantity)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity), 0), 2)
        END AS contribution_margin_pct
    FROM luxexperience.order_items oi
    JOIN luxexperience.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE oi.unit_price_eur IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.cost_eur IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.quantity IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.brand, p.category, p.brand_tier, oi.platform
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(AVG(contribution_margin_pct), 2) AS avg_contribution_margin_pct
    FROM product_contribution
    WHERE contribution_margin_pct IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.*,
        b.avg_contribution_margin_pct,
        ROUND(pc.contribution_margin_pct - b.avg_contribution_margin_pct, 2) AS margin_gap_pct,
        ROUND((pc.contribution_margin_pct - b.avg_contribution_margin_pct) * pc.revenue_eur / 100.0, 2) AS contribution_gap_eur
    FROM product_contribution pc
    CROSS JOIN benchmark b
    WHERE pc.contribution_margin_pct IS NOT NULL
      AND (pc.contribution_margin_pct < 0 OR pc.contribution_margin_pct < b.avg_contribution_margin_pct)
)
SELECT 
    'product' AS level,
    product_id AS entity_id,
    brand,
    category,
    brand_tier,
    platform,
    ROUND(revenue_eur, 2) AS revenue_eur,
    ROUND(cost_eur, 2) AS cost_eur,
    ROUND(contribution_eur, 2) AS contribution_eur,
    contribution_margin_pct,
    avg_contribution_margin_pct AS benchmark_margin_pct,
    margin_gap_pct,
    contribution_gap_eur
FROM flagged
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'brand' AS level,
    brand AS entity_id,
    brand,
    NULL AS category,
    NULL AS brand_tier,
    platform,
    ROUND(SUM(revenue_eur), 2) AS revenue_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(cost_eur), 2) AS cost_eur,

    ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(revenue_eur) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (SUM(contribution_eur) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_eur), 0)) - b.avg_contribution_margin_pct END, 2) AS margin_gap_pct,

  SELECT AVG(adj_ebitda_margin_pct) AS avg_margin_pct
  FROM luxexperience.financial_summary
),
segment_loss AS (
  SELECT
    'segment' AS entity_type,
    platform || ' - ' || segment || ' FY' || fiscal_year AS entity_name,
    fiscal_year,
    ROUND(adj_ebitda_eur_m * 1000000, 2) AS contribution_eur,
    adj_ebitda_margin_pct AS contribution_margin_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN adj_ebitda_eur_m < 0 THEN 'negative'
      WHEN adj_ebitda_margin_pct < (SELECT avg_margin_pct FROM segment_bench) THEN 'below_benchmark'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END AS status,
    CASE
      WHEN adj_ebitda_eur_m < 0 THEN ROUND(ABS(adj_ebitda_eur_m) * 1000000, 2)
      WHEN adj_ebitda_margin_pct < (SELECT avg_margin_pct FROM segment_bench)
      THEN ROUND(((SELECT avg_margin_pct FROM segment_bench) - adj_ebitda_margin_pct) * gmv_eur_m * 10000, 2)
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_eur
  FROM luxexperience.financial_summary
  WHERE adj_ebitda_eur_m < 0
     OR adj_ebitda_margin_pct < (SELECT avg_margin_pct FROM segment_bench)
),
product_bench AS (
  SELECT AVG(contribution_margin_pct) AS avg_margin_pct FROM (
    SELECT
      p.product_id,
      ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity), 0), 2) AS contribution_margin_pct
    FROM luxexperience.order_items oi
    JOIN luxexperience.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE oi.returned = FALSE
    GROUP BY p.product_id
  ) sub
),
product_loss AS (
  SELECT
    'product' AS entity_type,
    p.product_id AS entity_name,
    NULL::BIGINT AS fiscal_year,
    ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity), 2) AS contribution_eur,
    ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity), 0), 2) AS contribution_margin_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity) < 0 THEN 'negative'
      WHEN ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity), 0), 2) < (SELECT avg_margin_pct FROM product_bench) THEN 'below_benchmark'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END AS status,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity) < 0 THEN ROUND(ABS(SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity)), 2)
      WHEN ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price_eur - oi.cost_eur) * oi.quantity) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price_eur * oi.quantity), 0), 2) < (SELECT avg_margin_pct FROM product_bench)

      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_eur
  FROM luxexperience.order_items oi

)

FROM segment_loss

        product,

        LAG(mid_year_transactions) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY year) AS prev_transactions,
        LAG(avg_transaction_value) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY year) AS prev_avg_value
    FROM mid_year_sales
)

    product,
    year,
    mid_year_sales,
    mid_year_quantity,
    mid_year_transactions,
    ROUND(avg_transaction_value, 2) AS avg_transaction_value,
    ROUND((mid_year_sales - prev_sales) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_sales, 0), 2) AS sales_yoy_change_pct,
